title: Noise-softening earplugs
body: Turn the world's volume down a notch. Great for busy stores and loud classrooms.

title: A visual countdown timer
body: See time melt away instead of guessing. Lovely for focus sprints and transitions.

title: Weighted lap pad
body: A gentle, steady hug for your lap while you study, work, or wind down.

title: Quiet spinner ring
body: A silent fidget you can wear. Keeps busy fingers happy in meetings and class.

title: Soft-tint glasses
body: Take the harsh edge off bright screens and fluorescent lights.
